objective: Define the canonical audit-integrity and high-risk change-control baseline for NEXUS QUANT without provisioning logging/SIEM infrastructure.
scope: Define canonical audit event envelope and attribution
Define append-only/tamper-evident evidence and digest-chain direction
Define event/source/receive/observed time semantics and clock confidence
Define high-risk change attribution and maker/checker where required
Bind Human Gate evidence to exact action/resource/environment/digest
Define fail-closed behavior when critical audit path is unavailable
Define retention placeholder without jurisdiction assumption
Create machine-readable event/control matrix and diagrams
tests: Critical audit events have canonical attribution fields
Audit records cannot be silently overwritten in canonical policy
Audit writer cannot erase its own history
Raw secrets/tokens are forbidden in audit events
Maker/checker required for policy-defined highest-risk changes
Human Gate replay/scope substitution is detectable
Audit failure blocks HIGH/CRITICAL privileged mutation where required
Clock/time quality and source confidence are explicit
Country/location is not required as evidence
No logging infrastructure is falsely claimed provisioned
evidence: NIST SP 800-92 and current Log Management guidance
rollback: Revert P03-E policy artifacts and shared state/catalog changes; no runtime log infrastructure is modified.
